review_candidates.title: iOS Developer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain advanced iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI/UIKit. Collaborate with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, QA Engineers, and Backend Teams to deliver business requirements. Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Preferred Qualifications Experience with enterprise-scale mobile applications.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Swift, iOS frameworks, mobile architecture, and modern development practices while mentoring junior developers and driving technical excellence across the team. Collaborate with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, QA Engineers, and Backend Teams to deliver business requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 5+ years of hands-on iOS development experience. Strong expertise in Swift and Objective-C. Hands-on experience with App Store release management. Preferred Qualifications Experience with enterprise-scale mobile applications.
